name: SDN Host Storage Ingest Node
description: Capability node wrapping the host storage.ingest_with_source hostcall (loop C.8a): joins the parser's ingest meta JSON (schema + SourceTags provider/source/batch attribution, reconcile mode, archive naming, provenance) with the size-prefixed FlatBuffer record stream and the optional raw payload, forwards them as hostcall binary segments ({"$bin":0} records, {"$bin":1} archive raw), and emits the host's result JSON. Host-side behavior is policy-mediated by the dedicated storage_ingest capability grant (disk guardrail, batch store with source tags, source-batch reconcile, raw/provenance archiving).

externalInterfaces.description: Provenance/batch-capable record ingest through the host storage.ingest_with_source hostcall (sdn-server modulert/caps/storage.go).

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON storage.ingest_with_source meta authored by the parser node.

inputPorts.description: Ingest meta (attribution, reconcile, archive naming, provenance).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Optional raw source payload; archived by the host when the meta names an archive target.

methods.description: Persists one provenance-attributed record batch through the policy-mediated storage.ingest_with_source hostcall. BATCHING: every input port here is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is now ENFORCED IN CODE, not merely declared. maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are purely DECLARATIVE in the compiled flow runtime - space_data_module_runtime_begin_node_invocation pops the node whole queue port-blind up to the drain budget (64) - so a node that read ordinal 0 of a port and returned used to destroy every other frame it was handed there, with nothing re-delivering them and nothing logging the loss (live P1 cellular-multiprovider-returns-only-first-provider). A surplus is now refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count. See graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames. Merging is NOT the safe reading for this node: the meta frame carries POSITIONAL binary references (records is {"$bin":0}, the optional raw archive is segment 1) plus counts computed over exactly those bytes, so appending a second records frame would make the meta describe bytes it was never computed over.
